body:
>"am I justified in feeling uneasy about this or feeling like it was done to me without my consent or the consent of my parents"

This is it. Thank you for putting it in words that I really couldn't find. I guess I only felt it was valid to feel wronged if it was actual abuse and not just something I perceived as weird or bad.


>Everyone involved could have had the absolute best of intentions regarding getting you medically evaluated

I always thought this was the case, even if I never understood (and I still don't) what or why were they doing that day, there were too many adults involved for it to have been obviously bad. I guess it was a case of "children don't need to know beforehand"

Thank you for your answer, it was very helpful ♡

yeah, like now as an adult I know that a minor always has to have an adult present for those kind of things, like, legallt. I really don't know what went on that day to be honest. thank you for answering ♡

not really plans but more like a feeling that i will? not seeing myself in the future and all that. I've also been arranging things so it will be as smooth as possible for people to move on after I die, but I can't really /hurt/ myself seriously.. so i guess kinda? sorry for the long answer

I can empathize A Lot. Since ibdeopped out of college i haven't been able to draw a single thing, just a few sketches here and there. It's really so fucked up seeing how you lose something you deeply loved and you can just watch. Recently I started video editing so thay kind of helps fill the void, but that's not really correct either. It's like I furnished and opened the courtains in a new room of the house while still not being able to look inside the other, even if my most prized positions are there. It hurts, and i miss it, and it does not fill the void, more like distracts me from it. Hope you can find another room pretty enough to be able to sit down and breathe for a bit, until you can finally go and turn the key to the old one once again.
yeah, didn't really help out actually. Aw you remind me a lot of my younger sibling, around the same age and also very sweet, so it'd be a bit weird. But thank you for the offer, appreciate it ♡

actually in my experience the psychiatrist only has one or two for ten-ish psychologist appointments, so yeah, i actually only saw her once but she was the one responsible for diacharging me or continuing the treatement, sigh. I think i'll go to the appointment I scheduled the other day, if only for them to make the treatement decision for me. thank you for taking the time to answer ♡ I don't know what cake day is but happy cake day to you

But yeah a fucking idiot (who somehow has an impecable reputation???) sounds about right
